map.多段文本合并 使用指南: Merge Multiple Text Blocks User Guide
map.将多段分散文本按行或自定义分隔符合并为一段，可去空行与去重，适用于整理笔记、拼接: Merges several separate text blocks into one by line or with a custom separator, optionally dropping blank lines and duplicates. Great for organizing notes, stitching logs, and bulk text recombination, with local processing that never leaks content.
map.多段/多列拼接：把两个列表按行合并（如名字+邮箱成一行）。: Multi-block/multi-column stitching: merge two lists line by line (for example, name + email on one line).
map.文件片段连接：把分块文本拼成整体，准备发布。: File fragment joining: stitch chunked text into a whole piece, ready to publish.
map.分隔符定制：用逗号/制表符/换行连接，产出 CSV 或表格源。: Custom separator: join with comma, tab, or newline to produce CSV or a table source.
map.名字与邮箱按行合并: Merge Names and Emails Line by Line
map.：A 列「张三/李四」、B 列「z@x.com/l@y.com」，按行合并得「张: : column A "Zhang San/Li Si" and column B "z@x.com/l@y.com" merge line by line into "Zhang San,z@x.com" and "Li Si,l@y.com" — a ready two-column CSV.
map.两列行数不等怎么办？: What If the Two Columns Have Different Row Counts?
map.默认按较短截断或留空补齐（可选）；行数不等会错位，合并前先核对长度。: By default it truncates to the shorter one or pads with blanks (optional); unequal row counts cause misalignment, so check the lengths before merging.
map.逗号/制表符/空格/自定义均可；做 CSV 用逗号时，内容含逗号需转义，建议用制: Comma, tab, space, or a custom string all work; for CSV with commas, embedded commas must be escaped, so tab is usually safer.
